# LSR-2 tolerances, fits and finishes (generated by `cad/lsr2/tolerances.py`)

Authors: Anatol EA5KAO, Diego EA5JEF, Pedro Roca Molina (BricoHams). REV A0. Source of every number: `cad/lsr2/tolerances.py` and `cad/lsr2/params.py` (`TOL`). Tags: **D** DATASHEET (ISO 286-2 limits, ISO 492 normal bearing class), **P** PARAMETRIC (our choice, editable in the table), **M** MEASURE (shop capability: ask the shop). Fits follow the bearing-maker practice described in the script docstring: **VERIFY with the maker table for the real bearing and load before the first cut**. Related: [inspection sheet](LSR2_INSPECTION.md), [sizing](LSR2_SIZING.md), [route A](LSR2_ROUTE_A_CASTING.md), [route B](LSR2_ROUTE_B_CNC.md), [risks](LSR2_RISKS.md).

## Datums

| Datum | Definition |
|---|---|
| A | Body bottom mounting face (the face on the mast bracket); flatness 0.05; all heights are measured from it. |
| B | AZ axis: common axis of the two 6206 seats (Ø62) in the pillar. |
| C | EL axis: common axis of the two 6004 seats (Ø42) in the side wall bosses; height 268 above A. |

## Fits calculated from ISO 286-2 and ISO 492 limits (µm)

Hole = housing or bearing bore, shaft = shaft or bearing outer ring. Positive = clearance, negative = interference.

| Pair | Max clearance | Max interference |
|---|---|---|
| 62 J7 housing / 6206 outer ring | 31 | 12 |
| 42 J7 housing / 6004 outer ring | 25 | 11 |
| Ø30 g6 shaft / 6206 inner ring | 20 | 3 |
| Ø30 j6 shaft / 51206 shaft washer | 5 | 18 |
| Ø20 h6 shaft / 6004 inner ring | 13 | 10 |

## Casting and finishes

Sand casting A356-T6: general tolerance class ISO 8062-3 CT 9-10 (DATASHEET class; read the value for each nominal size in the standard); machining stock 2.5 mm per face (params.CAST, PARAMETRIC) absorbs it on the marked pads; everything else stays as cast. Printed pattern shrink factor 1.013.

| Surface | Finish |
|---|---|
| Machined fits and seats | Ra 0.8-1.6, no scratches along the axis, deburr and chamfer 0.5 x 45 deg |
| Gasket groove and lid face | Ra 1.6 flanks, 3.2 face |
| Cast surfaces | as cast Ra 12.5, shot-blast; no machining except the marked pads (stock 2.5 mm per face, params.CAST) |
| Aluminium parts | chromate conversion (conductive, default) or anodise; mask fits, threads and the electrical-continuity lands of lid and body |
| Stainless shafts | passivate; Tef-Gel on every joint with aluminium (galvanic corrosion at the coast) |
| Fasteners | A4-70 with Tef-Gel; torques in LSR2_ASSEMBLY |

## Open decisions

- Horizontal EL bores on route B (4th axis, angle plate or outsourced line boring): decides T06 and T13 capability.
- Doweling and line-boring the bolted slab stack of the body (T03).
- Real shop capabilities and the foundry CT class: replace the MEASURE capabilities and re-run the self-test.
- Fit selection (J7 / g6 / h6 / j6) to be confirmed with the maker table for the final load case; a tighter housing fit raises the preload risk in aluminium.
- Real mast and boom tube tolerances (MEASURE the first sample).
